description: Source code for an ATM driver for the Lantiq AR9 platform, including hardware initialization, firmware management, and core functions.

methods.name: ar9_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor) for the AR9 platform.

methods.name: ar9_init
methods.description: Initializes the AR9 ATM driver, setting up hardware and firmware.

methods.name: ar9_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the AR9 ATM driver, disabling hardware modules.

methods.name: ar9_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware execution on the AR9 platform by downloading code and restarting the processor.

methods.name: ar9_stop
methods.description: Stops the firmware execution on the AR9 platform.
